content.short: QuillAudits is a Web3 security firm focused on smart contract audits, wallet reviews, and live monitoring.
content.description: QuillAudits provides security services for blockchain teams that need external review before launch and monitoring after deployment. Its official site highlights smart contract audits, blockchain audits, wallet reviews, dApp pentests, incident response, vCISO support, and ongoing contract monitoring aimed at finding real exploit paths instead of only surface level issues. In the TON ecosystem, QuillAudits should be understood as a specialist security vendor that can review applications and infrastructure, not as a user facing protocol or wallet product.
content.meta: QuillAudits delivers smart contract audits, wallet reviews, pentests, incident support, and monitoring for blockchain teams globally.
